threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know someone’s new when they still say 'the tube' instead of 'the Overground' and look lost at Dalston Junction.
Caught a glimpse of a guy in a suit arguing passionately with a street artist about the meaning of life on the 133 last night. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I saw a guy in a onesie negotiating with a street vendor for a kebab at 3 a.m. on Sonnenallee.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it's common to see people drinking beer on park benches while discussing philosophy. No one bats an eye; just typical Berliner life.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they avoid the BART on Fridays, armed with their favorite taco spot’s exact hours instead.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo giving a heartfelt speech to the 38 Geary riders about love while we all just waited in the rain. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just all bohemian bars, but they miss the families who’ve been here for generations, still shopping at the same little shops.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they still stare at the metro map like it’s an ancient scroll. Locals just know to follow the crowd.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know you’re new if you still hesitate at the bus stop when the ‘W’ on the timetable stands for ‘Wait’ and not ‘Wandsworth’.
Last night on the 59, a chap serenaded the whole bus with 80s ballads. We all rolled our eyes but ended up clapping at his grand finale by Vauxhall.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a street artist painting a mural of a pigeon on a wall, while a kid next to him was feeding real pigeons. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a late-night döner while listening to impromptu DJ sets at the corner of Oranienstraße. It's chaos and magic.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their irritation at tourists taking photos in front of the murals but ignoring the smell of fresh tamales just steps away.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading waiting passengers at the Powell station with a ukulele. Perfectly off-key but somehow made the delay feel like a moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about trendy shops, but they miss the tiny bakeries tucked away on quiet streets where locals grab their morning pastries.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot a recent arrival by their struggle with the metro map; they still check for stops like it’s an ancient scroll.
